graphic.timer.description: Quiz countdown starts after measured speech during actual 2-6 second thinking silence.

audio.segments.description: Preserve exact dialogue with bounded internal silence and speed; no control tags in captions.

graphic.comparison.description: Locally rendered before/after cards with timed reveals.

graphic.process.description: Two to four numbered steps revealed inside measured narration.

graphic.callout.description: One large original typographic emphasis card.

scene.establish.description: Show a supplied background and up to four consistent cast cutouts.

speaker.closeup.description: Hide other actors; enlarge the active speaker to head and shoulders.

camera.slow_push.description: Small centered fixed-canvas zoom over this measured shot.

caption.phrase.description: Compact readable phrase matching the spoken unit.

caption.dialogue.description: Every original spoken word progressively revealed using local forced alignment; no summary-word substitution.

parameters.timing: measured local speech; estimated alignment boundaries retained

message.reveal.description: Reveal actual supplied message text, never a search instruction.

frame.stack.description: Relevant main visual over supplied decorative gameplay/ASMR.

effect.punch.description: Brief fixed-size zoom in a planned shot.

aura.gauge.description: Clearly playful negative-to-positive visual score over the progression preset.

audio.pause.description: Silence padding after a measured spoken unit.

audio.music_bed.description: Use a registered track with the format preset gain.

rank.card.description: Readable ranked title and original short reason on a usable poster.

notes: This dictionary describes supported planner fields; it is not an arbitrary blocks timeline interpreter.
Adobe adapters are planned and expose no executable blocks yet.
Custom JSON is our interchange contract, not a native Adobe project file.
Sound cue and emotion labels are planning metadata; dedicated stings and emotional speech are not automatically synthesized.
